vatInvoice.title: VAT invoice
vatInvoice.body: The owner can issue a VAT invoice for the rental paid to the owner. Share your invoicing details and confirm them directly with the owner.
vatInvoice.disclaimer: This is an arrangement between you and the owner: XePrime does not issue invoices on the owner's behalf, and amounts you pay to XePrime (such as the service fee) are not covered by this invoice.

terms.title: Rental terms & requirements
terms.instantBookHint: Valid requests inside the allowed hours are confirmed automatically.
terms.driverDepositNone: No deposit needed to hold the trip.
terms.acceptanceRequired: You must agree to the owner's terms when sending a request.

surcharges.title: Possible surcharges
surcharges.note: Surcharges are recorded at trip settlement and are not part of the displayed price.

mileage.title: Mileage allowance
mileage.included: Includes {km}/day. {fee} for each kilometre over the limit.
mileage.note: The allowance scales with the number of chargeable rental days. Excess mileage is only charged at settlement and is not part of the price shown.

items.hourly: Save more with hourly rental packages
items.noWait: Book fast, no need to wait for the owner to approve

general.purpose: Use the vehicle for its intended purpose — no prohibited goods, flammable or explosive materials, or livestock and poultry.
general.noSmoking: No smoking, chewing gum or littering inside the vehicle (a cleaning fee applies if broken).
general.handover: Pick up and return the vehicle within the agreed hours and keep it in its original condition.
general.tip: Tip: Take photos of the vehicle (exterior & odometer) at pick-up and return so both sides can compare.

threshold.graceMinutes: charged after {count, plural, one {# free minute} other {# free minutes}} of waiting

documents.licenceRequired: This service needs a verified driving licence on your account before you send a rental request.
documents.empty: The owner hasn't published specific requirements for this service — you'll be reminded what to bring when you send a request.

collateral.none: No deposit or collateral required: this vehicle needs no collateral or deposit at pick-up.
collateral.modeAsset: a motorbike or an asset of equivalent value
collateral.modeAssetTypes: a motorbike or an asset of equivalent value ({types})
collateral.unknown: No collateral required, or agree on it directly with the owner at handover.
collateral.note: Collateral (the pick-up deposit) is handed directly to the owner at pick-up and returned in full when the vehicle comes back intact.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & reservation policy
cancellation.free: Free cancellation: within {hours} hours of the owner accepting your trip (and no later than pick-up), you get back 100% of what you paid.
cancellation.hold: Reservation window: once the owner accepts your trip, you have {minutes} minutes to pay the reservation fee.
cancellation.release: If the reservation fee isn't paid in full in time, the request closes automatically and the vehicle's dates open up for other renters.
cancellation.protection: Renter protection: if the owner cancels after you have paid the reservation fee, you get back 100% of what you paid.
